meta.title: AI-Powered Business Analysis
meta.description: Generate story maps, business analysis documents and prototypes with AI. Built for business analysts and project managers.
meta.keywords: AI business analysis, story map generator, user story mapping, business analyst tool

hero.title: AI-Powered Business Analysis Platform
hero.subtitle: Generate story maps, business analysis documents and prototypes with AI in minutes.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Enter your project name and a brief description. AI will expand it into a detailed project overview.
howItWorks.step2Desc: AI creates a complete story map with epics, user stories, sprints, and release planning.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Turn your stories into business analysis documents, a clickable prototype, and test scenarios in one click.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Export your story map to Excel, share with your team, and start building.

features.title: Everything You Need
features.storyMapDesc: Automatically generate comprehensive story maps with R1/R2/R3 release planning.
features.bizAnalysisDesc: Generate R1, R2, R3 business analysis documents aligned with your story map.
features.prototypeDesc: Create interactive prototypes from your user stories.
features.testScenariosDesc: Generate detailed test scenarios for every user story.
features.exportDesc: Export story maps, documents and test scenarios in standard formats.
features.multilangDesc: Work in Turkish or English — AI generates content in your project language.

pricing.altBaslik: Choose the plan that fits your project. No credit card required.

terms.giris: By using KurgemX, you agree to the following terms. Please read carefully.
terms.s1Icerik: KurgemX is a SaaS platform operated by Ozan Kaan Karamık, offering AI-powered business analysis and prototyping services on a subscription basis.
terms.s2Icerik: You are solely responsible for the security of your account and all actions performed through it. You must keep your password secure and immediately notify destek@kurgemx.com of any unauthorized access.
terms.s3Icerik: The platform uses third-party AI services such as Anthropic's Claude model for content generation. Generated content is informational only and does not constitute professional advice. Evaluating the accuracy and suitability of this content is the user's responsibility.
terms.s4Icerik: KurgemX reserves the right to modify platform features, pricing, or terms of service with prior notice. Significant changes will be announced by email at least 30 days in advance.
terms.s5Icerik: These terms are governed by Turkish law. Istanbul courts have jurisdiction over any disputes.

privacy.giris: At KurgemX, we care about your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect and how we use it.
privacy.s1Icerik: We collect name, email address, and project content (stories, acceptance criteria, analysis texts). This data is used solely to provide the service.
privacy.s2Icerik: Your data is stored securely on Supabase infrastructure. Supabase applies industry-standard encryption and security measures.
privacy.s3Icerik: Project data is sent to the Anthropic API for content generation. Anthropic does not use this data for model training. Your data is not shared with advertisers or other third parties.
privacy.s4Icerik: The platform operates in accordance with Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK, Law No. 6698). Explicit consent for data processing is obtained during registration.
privacy.s5Icerik: To delete your account and all associated data, send a request to destek@kurgemx.com. Requests are processed within 30 business days.

refund.giris: The refund and cancellation policy applicable to KurgemX subscriptions is described below.
refund.s1Icerik: When you cancel your subscription, you retain full access to all features until the end of the current billing period. Access is not immediately revoked upon cancellation.
refund.s2Icerik: As long as you cancel before the next billing period begins, no charge will be made for the new period.
refund.s3Icerik: No refunds are issued for unused time remaining in the current period. Subscription fees are charged in advance at the beginning of each period.
refund.s4Icerik: The refund policy does not apply to the free Freemium plan.
